headline: Appointment of John Ellis Stilley to the Development Review Board, plus a consent agenda.
summary: A consent agenda groups routine items for a single vote. One of those items is a notice of openings on Burlington city commissions and boards, which will be placed on file.
items: Accept a notice of openings on Burlington city commissions and boards and place it on file
Appoint John Ellis Stilley as Development Review Board alternate, term expiring 6/30/27
